subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Blank
solution: The correct answer is **"Filled."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Blank"** means empty, with nothing written, printed or recorded on it. (खाली, कोरा) • **Example**: *This is a **blank**__ video.* • The antonym of **"Blank"** is **"Filled."** • **"Filled" **means crowded, packed, or stuffed. (खचाखच भरा हुआ, भरा हुआ) __ • **Example**: *That room is **filled**__.* • The opposite of **"filled"** is **"empty"**, which means having nothing inside. • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, "Valuate"**, means to assess the value or worth of something. (किसी चीज़ के मूल्य या मूल्य का आकलन करना) • **Option 2, "Trembled"**, means to shake involuntarily, especially from fear or excitement. ((ठंड, डर आदि के कारण) काँपना) • **Option 4, "Filed"**, means to arrange documents or papers in a particular order or place. (काग़ज़ात आदि को किसी एक स्‍थान पर सँभाल कर रखना ताकि उन्‍हें ढूँढ़ने में कोई परेशानी न हो; किसी वस्‍तु को फ़ाइल में रखना) 33:T722, The correct answer is **"was one of the glorious periods."**
